claim: This paper is the first reported FPGA hardware implementation of the L-Mul (linear-complexity multiplication) algorithm, targeting the FP8 (E4M3) data format used in LLM/NN inference.
stance_target: implementing a very recent (2024) approximate-multiplication algorithm in hardware is a viable, current novelty angle for a student FPGA project
scope_conditions: FPGA implementation of L-Mul, FP8 E4M3 format
quoted_support: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first FPGA-based FP8 approximate multiplier design.

claim: The proposed FP8 E4M3 L-Mul hardware design uses 22 LUTs, achieves a maximum frequency of 617 MHz with a critical-path delay of 4.85 ns, and reduces resource consumption by an average of 10% versus prior FPGA-based 8-bit approximate multipliers.
stance_target: concrete LUT/Fmax/delay numbers define what a 'publishable result' looks like for an FPGA arithmetic paper
scope_conditions: AMD Xilinx UltraScale+ (ZCU104 board), Vivado 2022.2 synthesis, FP8 E4M3 format
quoted_support: Compared to previous FPGA-based 8-bit approximate multiplier designs, our approach reduces resource consumption by an average of 10% while maintaining comparable performance.

claim: Integrating the L-Mul FP8 approximate multiplier into a CNN accelerator achieves a DSP-free implementation and reduces power consumption by 14.59% at the same 250 MHz operating frequency compared to an exact INT8 CNN accelerator baseline (117,067 LUTs, 1,156 DSPs).
stance_target: system-level (accelerator-integration) evaluation with power numbers strengthens the publishability of an arithmetic-unit paper
scope_conditions: CNN inference accelerator, 250 MHz operating frequency, INT8 exact baseline vs L-Mul FP8 E4M3 replacement
quoted_support: Thanks to the approximate multiplier design, we achieve a DSP-free implementation and reduce power consumption by 14.59% at the same operating frequency (250 MHz).

claim: The design was also integrated into a GCN inference accelerator (based on LW-GCN, INT8), achieving a DSP-free implementation and reduced power consumption at matched operating frequency.
stance_target: demonstrating cross-domain applicability (CNN and GCN) of a single arithmetic-unit design broadens a paper's contribution scope
scope_conditions: GCN inference accelerator based on LW-GCN, INT8 baseline replaced with L-Mul FP8 E4M3
quoted_support: we implement a GCN inference accelerator based on L-Mul (FP8, E4M3) using LW-GCN (INT8)... This design also achieves a DSP-free implementation at the same operating frequency and reduces overall power consumption.

claim: The L-Mul hardware design was built using CLB-level primitives (LUT_A through LUT_E and CARRY8 chains) to implement exponent addition, mantissa addition with carry-dependent mantissa correction, and post-processing, avoiding a full multiplier datapath.
stance_target: primitive-level (not behavioral) HDL design is a recurring theme across publishable FPGA arithmetic papers in this space
scope_conditions: AMD Xilinx UltraScale/UltraScale+ CLB structure (LUT6_2, 4-bit carry chains grouped into CARRY8)
quoted_support: By analyzing the CLB structure of AMD FPGAs, we achieve fine-grained optimization through primitive-based design.
